info.title: Hearth API
info.description: Hearth's HTTP API. Each environment serves it at the address in SSM `/hearth/<env>/api-url`. Generated from packages/shared/src/api (routes.ts, schemas.ts): edit those, then `pnpm api:spec`.

tags.description: Signed-in users (the web app): themselves, and the servers they own or are members of

tags.name: admin

tags.name: agent
tags.description: Game instances' agents, about their own server

post.summary: Approve a user (or take approval back)
post.description: Approved users may create servers. `{id}` is their user ID (`userId` from `/v1/me`, their Cognito sub); one person signed in with several providers is several users, each approved on its own.

200.description: The user, with their approval

400.description: The request is malformed (the message says how)

401.description: No ID token, or an invalid or expired one: sign in again

403.description: The caller is not a Hearth admin

404.description: No such user: they sign in once first

post.summary: Join a server with an invite
post.description: Any signed-in user, no approval needed. Makes the caller a member (see it, start and stop it); someone who already has access keeps their role.

200.description: The server, as the caller now sees it

401.description: No ID token, or an invalid or expired one: sign in again

404.description: No such invite: wrong, expired or revoked, or its server is destroyed

get.description: Also records the user on first sight (not yet approved) and refreshes their profile from the token.

200.description: The caller

401.description: No ID token, or an invalid or expired one: sign in again

post.summary: Create a server
post.description: Records it (PROVISIONING), owned by the caller, and runs the create workflow, which also starts it. The caller must be approved and under their server limit (destroyed servers don't count); `agentChannel` is for admins. Creating from an upload comes with the /v1 uploads.

400.description: The request is malformed (the message says how)

401.description: No ID token, or an invalid or expired one: sign in again

403.description: Not approved yet, at the server limit, or (not an admin) choosing an agent channel

cognito.description: The ID token from signing in through the environment's Cognito user pool (SSM /hearth/<env>/auth). It names the user and their profile; API Gateway checks it before the request reaches Hearth.

awsSigV4.name: Authorization
awsSigV4.description: AWS Signature Version 4 (IAM): admins with their AWS credentials, agents with their instance role

agent.description: The release this server's channel points at

restore.description: Replace the game data with this before starting the game

upload.description: An accepted upload to start with, instead of new game data

url.description: POST a multipart/form-data form here: every field in `fields`, then the file last as `file`

expiresAt.description: When the form stops working (ISO 8601, UTC)

code.description: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX: what a friend accepts (dashes, spaces and case don't matter)

expiresAt.description: When it stops working (7 days) (ISO 8601, UTC)

members.description: The owner first, then members by when they joined

cursor.description: Present when there are more; pass it back for the next page

name.description: Their display name, name or username, whichever their sign-in gave

addedBy.description: Who let them in: the invite's creator (the owner, for themselves)

admin.description: In the admin group: may act on every server

approved.description: May create servers (new users wait for an admin)

serverLimit.description: Servers they may own at once

provider.description: How they signed in: Google, Discord, or Cognito (a password)

key.description: A key from the backups list, or its file name; default the newest

force.description: Restore even though the last stop wasn't clean

id.description: Its file name, e.g. 20261005T120000Z.tar.gz: what a restore takes as `key`

unchanged.description: Nothing was started: the server was already in that state

ownerId.description: The owner's id: a Cognito sub, or an admin's IAM ARN

idleStopMinutes.description: Stop after this long with nobody playing; 0 = never; default 30

agentReportedAt.description: When the agent last reported (ISO 8601, UTC)

publicIp.description: Only while running; changes on every start

destroyedAt.description: When the destroy workflow finished (ISO 8601, UTC)

statusChangedAt.description: Set by every status change (ISO 8601, UTC)

lastOperationId.description: The latest claim; names its workflow execution

lastStopClean.description: The agent reported a clean stop (game saved)

stopReason.description: Why the last stop happened, when not asked for

lastBackupAt.description: When the newest backup finished (ISO 8601, UTC)

restoreKey.description: A pending restore: replaces the game data on the next start

restoreSource.description: restoreKey is an accepted upload; unset = a backup

restoreRequestedAt.description: When the restore was requested (ISO 8601, UTC)

address.description: Where players connect: the public IP, while it runs

gameState.description: The game inside, while it starts or runs

lastStopClean.description: False when the last stop may not have saved the game

restorePending.description: A restore will replace the game data on the next start

approved.description: true approves; false takes approval back

version.description: A newer release of the game

idleStopMinutes.description: Stop after this long with nobody playing (1–1440); 0 = never

serverLimit.description: Servers they may own at once
